welcome.label: Welcome · Kai’s treasure pouch

parts.label: ❓ The question
parts.title: What are they really made of?

welcome.script:
(Hold up something shiny, like a spoon or a foil ball, and squint at it.) Is this silver? How would you KNOW?

[ON SCREEN: The pouch]
The morning after Campfire Night, Kai panned the creek and came back with a pouch of treasure. Gold, silver, a diamond and an old coin. At least, that’s what his tags say.

[ON SCREEN: The question]
But Kai only looked at them. Today you’ll test each find like a detective and prove what it really is. Find four clues, then crack the case.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · the claim tower (Clue 1)

parts.label: 🏗️ The tower
parts.title: Can looks hold up a claim?

warmup.script:
(Hold up two things that look alike, like two pens.) Same color, same shape. Are they the same?

[ON SCREEN: Kai’s nugget]
Here’s Kai’s nugget from the creek.

[ON SCREEN: Museum gold]
And here’s real gold from a museum. They look almost the same!

[ON SCREEN: The tower]
Kai says his is gold. Stack evidence blocks under his sign and see if the tower holds. Then write what you notice, and Clue one is yours.

part1.label: Part 1 · fingerprint barcode (Clue 2)
part1.script:
(Press your thumb on the table, then look at it.) Your fingerprint is yours alone. Materials have one too!

[ON SCREEN: Fingerprint]
Run four tests on Kai’s silver bolt. Each one prints a stripe. Then slide your strip along the shelf until every stripe lines up. Which stripe proves it isn’t silver?

part3.label: Part 3 · fool’s gold! (the wow)
part3.script:
(Scribble with a pencil, then hold up the mark.) The mark is the color of the powder. Scientists call that a streak.

[ON SCREEN: Streak test]
In Part 3, rub each nugget on a white tile. Then try a steel nail on each one, and weigh them.

[ON SCREEN: A real streak]
Here’s a real streak test. Gold leaves a gold-yellow streak. So what do you think a dark streak means?

explore.label: Part 4 · build your claim (Clue 4)

parts.label: 🧾 Your claim
parts.title: I identify ___ as ___ because ___ and ___.
rows: Snap in two pieces of evidence

explore.script:
(Count on two fingers.) One piece of evidence? Not enough. Two? Now we’re talking.

[ON SCREEN: Your claim]
In Part 4, run tests on three samples and watch the table fill. Then build a claim for each one with two pieces of evidence. If your claim only has one, it bounces right back!

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: What did Kai really find?
parts.body: Use all four clues. Then two surprises.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
Use all four clues to name what Kai really found. Then test one more “silver” find, and write a museum label.

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Next, two short answers. For Part C, ask someone at home to pick three mystery things. Test them, fill your table, then sketch and label them. Last comes your CER.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “If a material is gray and hard, it must be iron.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
(Hold up a gray spoon or a key.) Gray. Hard. So it must be iron… right?

[ON SCREEN: The claim]
A classmate says anything gray and hard must be iron. Think about Kai’s coin and the suspect board.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts. Then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with: This shows that.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: ✨ Your specimen
parts.title: A chip of Kai’s fool’s gold
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ➡ Next lesson
parts.title: Physical changes
parts.body: Changes that don’t make anything new.

closing.script:
(Pretend to hand a nugget back.) Sorry, Kai. Not rich today!

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and a chip of fool’s gold goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Fool’s gold]
Remember: looks can fool you. Tests can’t.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Next lesson]
Next lesson: changes that don’t make anything new!

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
